name: steam-native-notifications
description: Mirror Steam notification toasts to the desktop notification daemon.
author: Ty Smith

scripts.build: bun tools/gen-proto.mjs && bun tools/gen-build-identity.ts && tsc --noEmit && starlight pack
scripts.test: tools/test-backend && bun tools/test-routes && bun tools/test-frontend && bun test tools/click-dispatch.test.ts tools/wayland-focus-protocol.test.ts tools/devtools.test.ts tools/mep.test.ts tools/snn.test.ts tools/toastdb.test.ts tools/capture.test.ts && bun test shared/contracts.test.ts shared/settings-policy.test.ts && bun test tools/presentation.test.ts && bun test tools/platform.test.ts && luajit tools/game-focus.test.lua && luajit tools/gamescope-focus.test.lua
scripts.build:standalone: bun tools/gen-proto.mjs && bun tools/gen-build-identity.ts && tsc --noEmit && bun standalone/build.ts
